# Fantasy buildings — curated starter collection

These three existing stylized assets have been grouped by their visually matching
fantasy-building theme. This is a **starter collection**, not a complete playable
level or a guaranteed compatible asset pack. The exterior contact sheets have been
inspected for this grouping; interiors, collision, scale and engine compatibility
have not been verified as a set.

- [Mushroom house](../../assets/buildings/houses/fantasy/g3-mushroom-house/) · [inspection views](../../assets/buildings/houses/fantasy/g3-mushroom-house/previews/contact-sheet.jpg)
- [Witch cottage](../../assets/buildings/houses/fantasy/g3-witch-cottage/) · [inspection views](../../assets/buildings/houses/fantasy/g3-witch-cottage/previews/contact-sheet.jpg)
- [Fairy-tale castle](../../assets/buildings/landmarks/fantasy/g3-castle/) · [inspection views](../../assets/buildings/landmarks/fantasy/g3-castle/previews/contact-sheet.jpg)

Each original folder contains its own license, provenance, model and recorded review.
See the [license audit](../licenses.md) for limitations. No files are duplicated here.
